name: Liquidity Pool Daily Rebalancer
description: Rebalances a Soroban AMM pool at midnight UTC every day to restore the target reserve ratio. The pool contract emits a rebalance_executed event with the amounts moved and the resulting ratio.
author: example-org

params.name: caller
params.doc: The operator account authorising the rebalance.

topics.doc: The caller account that triggered the rebalance.

dataFields.name: token_a_moved
dataFields.doc: Amount of token A moved (positive = added, negative = removed).

dataFields.name: new_ratio
dataFields.doc: Reserve ratio after rebalancing, scaled to 7 decimal places.
